newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London led by FTSE, HSBC rise.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London led by FTSE, HSBC rise.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks trading in London were led higher on Wednesday on the back of gains in HSBC which tracked the FTSE and leading UK bank stocks higher.
"The market has once again been led by Hongkong bank, completely led by the FTSE, where the banks have picked up after Standard Chartered's interim results," said one trader.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 53.63 points at 16,595.23.
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng climbed 170 points or 1.04 percent to a record 16,541.6 on renewed interest in property stocks.
In London HSBC was trading at HK$271.5 compared with HK$269 in Hong Kong.
Elsewhere, dealers said the market was being influenced by the a FTSE 100 and a positive start for the Dow.
